## Detailed System Architectures & Flagship Projects

### 1. InterviewIQ — AI-Powered Remote Technical Assessment Platform
- **Award**: 1st Place Winner at SDS Hackathon (Hack & Forge 2026), BIT Mesra
- **Live Demo**: https://ai-interviewer-eight-navy.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Yash122005/AI_INTERVIEWER
- **Problem Solved**: Unproctored technical interviews suffer from severe evaluation bottlenecks and lack of real-time integrity verification.
- **Architectural Implementation**:
  - Built with a React client and an Express.js / Node.js REST API layer backed by MongoDB for persistence and ImageKit for audio/visual media streaming.
  - Features real-time client integrity observers: multi-face detection via client webcam stream, clipboard interception (copy/paste prevention and audit logs), and browser focus loss tracking.
  - AI pipelines synthesize dynamic role-specific interview prompts and automatically evaluate responses against quantitative scoring rubrics.
  - Generates comprehensive PDF candidate evaluation dossiers for engineering recruiters.

### 2. HirePoint — Role-Based Talent & Service Marketplace
- **Live Demo**: https://hire-point-fs27.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Yash122005/HirePoint
- **Problem Solved**: Traditional job portals blur lines between candidate, recruiter, and administrator roles, causing security vulnerabilities and poor onboarding UX.
- **Architectural Implementation**:
  - Full-stack marketplace engineered with React, Tailwind CSS, Clerk identity management, and Supabase PostgreSQL.
  - Implements strict Row-Level Security (RLS) policies in PostgreSQL, isolating recruiter job postings, candidate applications, and administrator oversight.
  - Multi-step onboarding and document verification flow before profiles appear in public marketplace searches.
  - Persistent real-time application tracking with Supabase serverless storage.

### 3. Interview Prep Planner — GenAI Resume Analyzer & Roadmap Engine
- **Live Demo**: https://resume-analyser1-85v2.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Yash122005/Interview-Prep-Planner
- **Problem Solved**: Job seekers lack structured, quantitative feedback on resume deficiencies against target job descriptions and need actionable daily study regimens.
- **Architectural Implementation**:
  - 4-layer React architecture separating presentation, custom hooks, application context, and API service clients.
  - Node.js + Express backend utilizing HTTP-only cookie JWT authentication with token revocation blacklisting.
  - Automated PDF resume parsing compared semantically with target job descriptions using Google Gemini API.
  - Utilizes strict runtime Zod schema enforcement over LLM outputs, ensuring 100% deterministic JSON objects for technical/behavioral question banks and day-by-day learning roadmaps.

### 4. Value Education Cell — BIT Mesra Official Web Platform
- **Role**: Web Developer, Value Education Cell, BIT Mesra
- **Live Demo**: https://value-education-cell-bitm.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Yash122005/Value-Education-Cell---BITM
- **Problem Solved**: The campus cell needed a high-performance, authoritative digital portal to publish institutional initiatives, archives, and faculty event calendars.
- **Architectural Implementation**:
  - Architected using Next.js with Static Site Generation (SSG) for sub-second paint times on mobile networks.
  - Choreographed editorial typography and scroll-linked interactions using GSAP and Tailwind CSS.
  - High accessibility (WCAG AA compliant) with semantic navigation and responsive imagery.

### 5. Spotify-Inspired Music Streaming REST Backend
- **Documentation**: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/46428929/2sBXwqqVsv
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Yash122005/Spotify-backend-
- **Architecture**: Node.js and Express.js REST API with MongoDB data modeling for audio tracks, user playlists, and authenticated streaming endpoints. Documented with interactive Postman collections.

### 6. Real-Time Foreign Exchange (FX) Utility
- **Live Demo**: https://currency-convertor-tau-livid.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Yash122005/Currency-Convertor/tree/main/src
- **Architecture**: React application with custom hooks for asynchronous FX rate feeds, debounced numerical calculation, and base-pair inversion.
